verdicts.criticalReason: PR #0 commits build and generated artifacts under the target/ directory (e.g. .class files, Maven logs, surefire reports) as well as the database binary file (data/appdb.mv.db). It also used the incorrect Flyway version (V20260726003721423 instead of the mandated V20260726003721485).

concerns: The PR modifies an existing database migration file (V20260726003554409__crm_query_optimization_schema.sql) instead of creating a new one, which can cause validation/checksum errors on environments where the migration has already run.
